blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse for Payments & Cards — trusted data at decision speed — pipelines, lakehouse and governance that stand up to audit applied to the payments & cards operating unit of Banking & Financial Services.

Payments is a real-time decision business wearing a compliance uniform: instant rails compress fraud windows to seconds, authorization economics reward millisecond latency, and every innovation (click-to-pay, tokenized wallets) inherits the same decision spine.

items: Fraud and risk enrichment adds milliseconds that cost approval rates; batch components cannot sit on the instant path.
Issuer, acquirer, wallet and scheme data reconcile in nightly files; dispute and fraud analytics lag events.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Real-Time Streaming & Event-Driven Decisioning, Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics, Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Authorization decisioning, Chargeback/dispute handling, Scheme settlement reconciliation) on Fleet Management System and EEMS Platform. Governance inherits the sector frame — PCI DSS 4.0 among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Forward-looking risk on governed data — credit, insurance, operational and market models that explain themselves.
Turn the data estate into revenue — embedded analytics, data sharing and insight products with real P&L.
Resilient, observable pipelines — trusted data from source to decision at SLA.
event-streamed transactions into fraud/dispute analytics (issues caught at event time)

blocks.caption: Regimes shaping this capability
rows: cardholder-data estate compliance with continuous expectations
